verses.html: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.text: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.title: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth.
verses.titleHtml: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth.

verses.html: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
verses.text: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;

verses.html: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
verses.text: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

verses.html: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
verses.text: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.

verses.html: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.
verses.text: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.

verses.html: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
verses.text: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

verses.html: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.text: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

verses.html: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
verses.text: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.

verses.html: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
verses.text: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.

verses.html: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

verses.html: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.text: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
